question: If the area of the base of a cylinder is 3850 cm² and its height is twice the radius of its base, then find the volume of the cylinder. [Use π = (22)/(7)]
solution:
**Given:**

Area of the base of the cylinder (A) = 3850 cm²

Height (h) = 2 × radius (r)

π = 22/7

**Formula used:**

Area of the base (A) = π r²

Volume of the cylinder (V) = π r² h
